desc:
Eight million people. One city. It needs heroes.

Welcome to Meridian City. Every hero starts with every power: flight, heat vision, frost breath, super strength and lifting.

🦸 FLY: skim the bay, weave through skyscrapers, break the sound barrier and keep climbing to the Moon.
🔥 SAVE THE CITY: catch falling window washers, put out fires, rescue choppers and stop the getaway van.
🤖 FIGHT BOSSES: take down IRONCLAD in the streets and THE WARDEN above the skyline.
🏁 RACE & EXPLORE: beat the clock in sky races and hunt for 20 hidden Hero Medals.
👥 CO-OP OR SOLO: team up with friends or protect Meridian on your own.
✨ EARN HERO POINTS: spend them on capes, flight trails and emblems.

Controls
PC: F fly · Shift boost · E heat · Q frost · Click punch · G lift · B shop
Controller: Y fly · L3 boost · R2 heat · L2 frost · R1 punch · X lift
Mobile: on-screen buttons

The sky is yours. Take flight.
